newsitem.title: USA: Baldwin Piano says directors reelected.
newsitem.headline: Baldwin Piano says directors reelected.

text.p: Baldwin Piano & Organ Co said Thursday that preliminary indications are that shareholders have voted overwhelmingly to re-elect the company's five-member board at its annual meeting today.
The company-backed directors were running against a slate proposed by Bolero Investment Group LP, of Newport Beach, Calif.
The company said the vote is subject to verification by independent inspectors of election, and a final shareholder vote tally is expected next week.
Said Karen L. Hendricks, Baldwin chairwoman and chief executive officer, "The overwhelming vote in our favor gives us a clear mandate to continue executing our strategic growth plan for Baldwin."
Hendricks said at the meeting that Baldwin has taken steps to reduce its costs and improve efficiency at its four piano-making plants and that those efforts were already showing results.

She also said that the company's newest products -- Baldwin's digital Pianovelle, and its acoustic piano autoplayer, the Baldwin ConcertMaster -- will contribute significantly to the company's future success.

The company, she said, is also studying global expansion for its acoustic piano business. "With the U.S. representing less than 20 percent of the world market, and the remainder overseas, we are developing products to appeal to these markets and have hired experienced sales representatives to explore these opportunities," said Hendricks.
